Growth at that pace usually means more enterprise AI accounts in play than the team can cover before they go cold. Our AI SDR researches, writes, and follows up autonomously, so coverage scales without new headcount: 3-5x more meetings per rep.

I built a personalized signal play for SuperAnnotate off your hiring and tech-stack signals, and accounts showing them tend to progress about 4.4x faster. Worth 15 minutes for me to walk you through it?

Post-raise, board expectations on pipeline usually climb faster than headcount can. Most teams do not actually know how many meetings they need to book to hit the new number, so the gap shows up late and the quarter turns into a recovery effort.

Want to grab 15 minutes? I will walk you through our pipeline model and show exactly how many meetings SuperAnnotate needs to close that gap this quarter, plus where the math breaks if you only add reps.
